title: Walk into any tech startup and you'll see MacBooks everywhere. Is mac...
description: Walk into any tech startup and you'll see MacBooks everywhere. Is macOS actually better for programming, or is it just Apple's branding? 👇 🐧 Unix → macOS is built on Unix, so it feels a lot like the Linux servers your code actually runs on. ssh, grep, curl, git and Homebrew work out of the box. ⚡ Apple Silicon → CPU, GPU and accelerators on one chip. Great performance per watt means an IDE, dev servers and browser tabs running all day, off the charger. 📱 Ecosystem → Xcode only runs on macOS. If you build for iPhone, a Mac is usually a requirement. ✨ Developer experience → polished apps next to a powerful command line, plus the trackpad, display and build quality you stare at all day. But Macs aren't perfect: 💸 They're expensive, and you can't upgrade them after purchase 🐳 Docker on a Mac runs inside a lightweight Linux VM, so it's not quite native Windows is excellent for .NET and desktop apps, and WSL gives you a real Linux environment. Linux dominates servers and gives you full control. 💡 The best OS is the one that fits your tools, your workflow, and what you're building. For many developers, the Mac just happens to hit all three. Team Mac, Team Windows, or Team Linux? 👀 #programming #macos #developer #softwareengineering #techexplained
